doc.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Writing lyrics for Don Cherry's Remembrance
summary: Rediscovering the heavy lyrics she wrote, she doubts she wrote them.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But I, but, you know, and then I found them… I guess I still have them over there. I thought I didn‟t have them, but if found them one day when you were here. We were rehearsing. Brown, C.: Yes.
And I was reading them and I said, “Oh, man, these are pretty heavy lyrics.”
Not to brag, but I thought… and then I doubted… I said, “Did you write those?” [laughs] I said, “Did you really write those?” Brown, C.: You did.
